## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//make:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//make:defs.bzl", "make_library")
```

## Rules

### `make_library`

Owns the Makefiles of one package for dx lint (checkmake) and dx format (mbake).

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Makefiles of this package: Makefile, makefile, GNUmakefile or *.mk. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | Other make libraries this package depends on. |
